benefits.name: Free Checked Bags
benefits.description: Two free checked bags on Frontier-operated flights for the primary cardmember.
benefits.terms: Applies to the primary cardmember on Frontier Airlines-operated flights when the ticket is purchased with the card.

benefits.name: Zone 2 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Complimentary Zone 2 priority boarding on Frontier flights.

benefits.name: Instant Elite Gold Status
benefits.description: Instant Frontier Elite Gold status after the first purchase, upgrading boarding priority and other elite perks.
benefits.terms: Granted instantly after first purchase. Requires $3,000 in card spend within the first 90 days of account opening to retain Elite Gold status for 12 months.

benefits.name: Anniversary Flight Discount Voucher
benefits.description: $100 Frontier Airlines flight discount voucher issued each account anniversary.
benefits.terms: Requires $2,500 or more in card spend during the cardmember year to earn the voucher.

benefits.name: Award Booking Fee Waiver
benefits.description: Waives Frontier's award redemption/booking fee when booking an award ticket and paying the taxes and fees with the card.
benefits.terms: Applies to Frontier Miles award ticket redemptions when taxes and fees are paid with this card.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases directly with Frontier Airlines (flyfrontier.com, reservations, onboard, and airport ticket counters).
